concerns.concern: The paper presents a single tunnel junction. It does not say how many devices or cooldowns were measured, how many showed the effect, or why others were set aside. A second device or dataset should be shown for the mass and entropy results.
concerns.quote: State how many junctions and cooldowns you measured, and show the second-best one next to Fig. 3a and Fig. 4c.

concerns.concern: The swings in dμ/dn may include an exchange-correlation (interaction) contribution that the paper's formula assigns entirely to effective mass. The authors admit the expression is only qualitative for correlated carriers, and the mass is not measured independently.
concerns.quote: Compare dμ/dn with 1/ρ from Eq. 6 on the same data; the difference estimates the interaction term that Eq. 4 assigns to m*.

concerns.concern: The extracted dμ/dn depends on dividing by an exponential transmission background with exponent 0.258, whose origin and uncertainty are not given. The raw dI/dVg is shown only after normalization, so it is unclear whether the negative dips and masses survive changes to this background.
concerns.quote: How was the exponent 0.258 in T(n) obtained, what is its uncertainty, and how do the negative dμ/dn dips in Fig. 2a and the masses in Fig. 3a change

concerns.concern: Eq. 3 approximates Methods Eq. 7 by dropping the ρ(EF)/ρ(EF + eVb) factor and depends on the capacitances Cb/Cg. It is unclear how large the dropped factor is at ±42 mV, how the ~20 meV phonon offset enters the probed energy, and whether dμ/dn keeps its shape at other bias voltages.
concerns.quote: How large is ρ(EF) compared with ρ(EF + eVb) at Vb = ±42 mV across the flat bands

concerns.concern: The entropy extraction sets the chemical potential at charge neutrality to zero at every temperature. The reviewer asks how the entropy plateaus change if this value is allowed to drift with temperature.
concerns.quote: How do Fig. 4c and Extended Fig. 4c change if μ at the CNP is allowed to drift with temperature

concerns.concern: Carriers may be confined in a potential well under the planar tunneling electrode, which can produce Coulomb-diamond features, as the authors' own group reported before. The 0.3 K maps have not been checked for such features, and the doping offset under the probe is not reported.
concerns.quote: Look in the 0.3 K maps (Fig. 1b, Extended Fig. 2a, b) for extra charging lines spaced by a charging energy, and report the CNP offset under the probe.

concerns.concern: Twist-angle inhomogeneity across the ~1 µm² junction has not been bounded. The twist angle should be fitted separately from independent features, and feature widths used to bound the spread.
concerns.quote: Fit n0 separately from the CNP fan, each Chern insulator line and the ±4 gaps, and use the feature widths to bound the angle spread

concerns.concern: The twist angle is quoted inconsistently in different parts of the paper (1.06°, 1.08°, 1.07°). This raises the question of whether all the data come from the same device.
concerns.quote: The twist angle reads 1.06° ± 0.02° (p. 3), 1.08° (Fig. 1b caption, p. 6) and 1.07° (Methods, p. 22); are these one device?

concerns.concern: Entropy values come from a linear fit over only three adjacent temperature points. The reviewer asks whether the plateaus are robust when more points are used.
concerns.quote: and if the fit uses more than three adjacent temperature points?

concerns.concern: The entropy plateaus could be tested with an in-plane magnetic field, as in prior Pomeranchuk-effect work where entropy is quenched by such a field.
concerns.quote: is quenched by an in-plane field, a field test you could apply to your plateaus.

concerns.concern: The choice of the shown parameter ranges is not explained, including the ±42 mV bias and the 4.2 to 36 K entropy window. It is also not said whether other ranges were measured, such as the hole side for the entropy and fields above 6 T.
concerns.quote: the choice of Vb = ±42 mV and of the 4.2 to 36 K entropy window is not explained.

concerns.concern: The processing chain from raw data to figures is incomplete. The T(n) fit and quantum capacitance correction are in an SI not included, no code is given, and data are only available on request.
concerns.quote: the T(n) fit and quantum capacitance correction sit in an SI not in this PDF, no code is given
